segments.say: White to move. One knight jump attacks the king, the queen and the rook at once.
segments.caption: Find the knight jump

segments.say: Knight f7, check! King, queen and rook are all attacked.
segments.caption: Knight f7!

segments.say: The king has to move. And the knight takes the queen, safely.
segments.caption: Bye bye queen

segments.say: White is now a full queen up. This is called a family fork. Did you find it?

yt_title: One knight attacks EVERYTHING 🐴 Family Fork #chesspuzzle
desc:
White to move: one knight jump attacks the king, queen AND rook.

Answer: Nf7+! The king must move, and the knight takes the queen on d8 - White is a full queen up. This is called a FAMILY FORK.
